scope: Exact all-time responses under one common scale and a single actually implemented finite algebraic selective-delay channel. Pre/postoperations, ancillas and readout can depend on n but not on t; output means are unconditional linear means, not conditionally normalized postselection ratios. Arbitrary state amplitudes are allowed. This does not rule out the new balanced 10/01 interferometer, independent freely n-dependent scales, supplied transcendental relative energies/timing, t-dependent controls, finite-time approximation or infinite spectral limits.
